ABOUT_PAGE.DESCRIPTION: SkyInfo brings together flight information, airport navigation, visa requirements and travel documents to make planning and travelling easier.
ABOUT_PAGE.WHAT_DESCRIPTION: SkyInfo brings together the most important information passengers may need before and during their journey. Instead of using several different services, users can find flight information, check entry requirements, manage travel documents and navigate through the airport in one place.
ABOUT_PAGE.FEATURES_TITLE: Everything you need for your journey
ABOUT_PAGE.FLIGHTS_DESCRIPTION: Search for flights, view departure and arrival times, terminals, gates and other important information, and keep track of selected flights.
ABOUT_PAGE.MAP_DESCRIPTION: Explore an interactive airport map and find a route between selected locations with step-by-step navigation.
ABOUT_PAGE.VISA_DESCRIPTION: Check visa requirements, passport validity and additional travel conditions based on your document and destination.
ABOUT_PAGE.DOCUMENTS_DESCRIPTION: Store and manage your primary and additional travel documents used when planning your journey.
ABOUT_PAGE.STEP_ONE_DESCRIPTION: Create an account and add your travel document, or use the basic features of the application as a guest.
ABOUT_PAGE.STEP_TWO_DESCRIPTION: Find your flight, check visa requirements and explore the airport before your journey begins.
ABOUT_PAGE.STEP_THREE_DESCRIPTION: Keep the information you need before and during your journey available in one place.
ABOUT_PAGE.PROJECT_DESCRIPTION: SkyInfo was developed as a graduation project to demonstrate the development of a modern web application and the integration of external services for flight information, airport navigation and travel requirements into a unified passenger information system.
ABOUT_PAGE.CTA_DESCRIPTION: Find the information you need before takeoff and organize your journey with SkyInfo.
